links.surface: عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ

notes: «أَبِي رَحِمَهُ اَللَّهُ» is the compiler's father, kept as narrator and the blessing left out; «ع» after Ja'far is a blessing; «سَأَلْتُهُ» has a pronoun for an Imam who is not named in the text, so no link is added (doubt); the matn begins at «عَنِ اَلْمَلَكَيْنِ»
